name: k-Nearest-Neighbor Graph Construction
limitation_notes: A matching input variant can qualify without supporting every optional mode. Missing canonical adapters and absent runtime validation remain separate from research collection eligibility.

research_coverage.method: Problem-contract audit against pinned library implementations, existing author artifacts and targeted publication/repository searches.
research_coverage.shortfall: Fewer than three eligible local GPU implementation/research-paper pairs; individual records state missing artifacts or variant restrictions.

algorithms.notes: Query every input vector against a GPU flat index and remove its own ID. Distinct vectors with identical values remain valid neighbors. k+1 retrieval and tie handling must preserve k non-self outputs.
CUDA nearest-neighbor graph operator used by the PyG ecosystem. Respect the pinned kernel k limit, batch partitioning, distance convention and self-loop flag.
Approximate kNN graph construction; recall must be measured. The cuVS implementation cites GPU NN-Descent. CAGRA navigation-graph pruning is not treated as an exact kNN output.
